# Test fixtures

Real responses from the RIS Open Government Data API (Bundeskanzleramt Österreich,
[ris.bka.gv.at](https://www.ris.bka.gv.at)), licensed under
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Retrieved November 2026.

- `NOR40105099.xml`: § 1 Mietrechtsgesetz (MRG), unmodified.
- `search_mrg.json`: a search response for the MRG (`Fassung.FassungVom` set), trimmed to three
  documents and some metadata fields; the structure is unchanged.
